description: The Barracuda Cryptographic Software Module is a cryptographic software library that provides fundamental cryptographic functions for applications in Barracuda security products that use Barracuda OS v2.3.4 and require FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic functions.

oes.name: Barracuda OS v2.3.4 on Intel Xeon, Intel Xeon with AES-NI, AMD Opteron, AMD Opteron with AES-NI
